commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot view deadlines and events for a specific date without
scanning the entire task list.

Add an on command that lists deadlines due on the requested date and
events spanning it. Preserve original task numbers so follow-up
commands continue to target the correct tasks.

The chatbot classes are stored in the default package, which makes
component boundaries unclear as the project grows.

Move the classes under the bot package with exception, parser,
storage, task, and ui subpackages. Update package declarations,
imports, documentation, and the UI test runner for the packaged main
class.

This structure groups classes by responsibility while keeping
src/main/java as the source root and preserving existing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align Java code with SE-EDU conventions
commitResults.messageBody:
The Java sources use inconsistent import grouping, terse date and file
variable names, and parameter descriptions without terminal punctuation.

Align imports and Javadocs with the SE-EDU coding standard. Rename
parser, storage, deadline, and event variables to clarify their purpose.
Keep chatbot behavior and persisted data formats unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add SE-EDU Java coding standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Java changes need a repeatable project-specific reference for naming,
layout, imports, statements, and documentation.

Add a reusable skill based on the SE-EDU basic and intermediate Java
standard. Require agents to invoke it for future Java changes and
reviews so conventions remain consistent.

Commit messages and branch names need consistent project guidance.

Add a reusable skill based on the SE-EDU Git conventions. Require
agents to inspect the relevant diff and validate future commit metadata.
Preserve authorization boundaries so drafting a message never implies
permission to commit or push.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task search by description keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot narrow the task list when looking for a specific item.

Add a find command that searches task descriptions without regard to
case while preserving match order. Handle missing keywords and empty
results, and cover the behavior with JUnit and console UI tests.
